mentions.name: Superego
mentions.description: This open-source, local database collects all your personal data, hooks it up to a bring-your-own LLM, and provides an assistant that can answer any question about your life. It also lets you vibe-code (or just code) small apps on top of your data, such as a custom dashboard for your expenses.
